anomalies.description: A man in dark clothing engages in a physical confrontation with an unseen opponent in a dimly lit industrial corridor; he is struck, stumbles, is thrown backward, and appears to be overpowered and subdued while pigeons scatter around him.
A visible muzzle flash and smoke plume emanate from a handgun held by the man as he fires at an off-screen target; the recoil and smoke are clearly captured.
A visible muzzle flash and smoke plume emanate from the man's right hand at 18.5s, consistent with a firearm discharge in close proximity.

A physical fight occurs in a dim corridor: one person is thrown backward (f0), then appears inverted mid-air (f1), followed by a blur of motion suggesting impact or grappling (f2), and finally lies on the ground while another figure moves away (f3–f6). The sequence shows mutual combat with clear physical contact and displacement.

One individual is seen lying on the ground while another stands over them; the prone person appears incapacitated and is subsequently struck or kicked (visible motion blur and posture suggest impact).
Simultaneous engagement: while one person is on the ground, another figure (in tactical gear) moves aggressively toward them, suggesting continued combat or intervention in the fight.

After being thrown, the victim lies prone on the floor (f5–f6) while the attacker stands over them and appears to deliver a downward strike or stomp (f5 shows raised leg/foot near victim’s torso; f6 shows attacker leaning over victim). This suggests an attack on a helpless individual.
